usedFor: Zoho CRM holds leads, contacts and deals, and Hastewire rewrites text through “Humanize Text” so it sounds natural.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: The action rewrites text so it sounds natural, which suits notes and messages written around a new lead.

watchOut: “New or Updated Lead” in Zoho CRM fires on updates too, so the same lead can run “Humanize Text” twice.
